epic.title: Extract Gold from Claude/Codex Chat Logs
epic.description: Mine 715MB of chat history for plans, loose ends, scripts, and actionable knowledge. Ingest into existing RAG brain.

stories.title: Create unified chat log parser
stories.description: Parse Claude history.jsonl (720 entries), Codex history.jsonl (442 entries), and 931 session transcript lines into unified ConversationTurn format
acceptanceCriteria: All 1162+ chat entries parsed without errors
Unified ConversationTurn dataclass with timestamp, session_id, content, source
JSONL output at ~/.roxy/knowledge/parsed_conversations.jsonl
Code blocks extracted separately with language detection

stories.title: Implement knowledge extractor with regex + LLM
stories.description: Extract structured knowledge using fast regex patterns and Ollama LLM for nuanced extraction
acceptanceCriteria: Regex extraction for: TODO, FIXME, shell scripts, error patterns
LLM extraction using existing deep-reflector.md prompt
Confidence scoring (0-1) for each extracted item
Knowledge types: PLAN, TODO, SCRIPT, PROBLEM, SOLUTION, INSIGHT, DECISION
Output: ~/.roxy/knowledge/extracted_{type}.jsonl for each type

stories.title: Ingest extracted knowledge into RAG brain
stories.description: Use existing PostgresMemory.remember() and ChromaDB to store extracted knowledge with embeddings
acceptanceCriteria: Reuse existing PostgresMemory.remember() - no new tables
Reuse existing ingest_rag.py chunking (1000 chars, paragraph boundaries)
All knowledge items have embeddings (384-dim)
Queryable via /memory/recall endpoint
Deduplication against existing brain docs (SHA256 check)

stories.title: Generate actionable reports
stories.description: Generate LOOSE_ENDS.md, SCRIPTS_CATALOG.md, DECISIONS.md from extracted knowledge
acceptanceCriteria: LOOSE_ENDS.md: All TODOs sorted by priority with source links
SCRIPTS_CATALOG.md: All extracted shell scripts with descriptions
DECISIONS.md: Architectural decisions with rationale
Each report has table of contents and search-friendly format

stories.title: Create extraction orchestrator with monitoring
stories.description: Main orchestrator script that runs full pipeline with progress tracking and error handling
acceptanceCriteria: Single entry point: python extraction_orchestrator.py
Progress bar with ETA
Error handling with resume capability
Statistics output: items parsed, extracted, ingested
Can run in background with nohup

stories.title: Launch on Mac Studio and monitor
stories.description: Deploy extraction pipeline to Mac Studio, launch ROXY mission, and monitor first hour
acceptanceCriteria: Scripts synced to Mac Studio via SSH
Full extraction run completed
Reports generated and accessible
Knowledge queryable via /memory/recall
